list: the official 55 trophies: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze (28 hidden on PSN until earned)
basis: Names, descriptions and grades: the official PS5 list (as listed by Exophase, https://www.exophase.com/game/grand-theft-auto-vi-psn/trophies/, and PSNProfiles, https://psnprofiles.com/trophies/43531-grand-theft-auto-vi). Kinds: derived by SUNLINE from those descriptions. Roadmap stages and missable flags: from the descriptions plus PowerPyx and OutputLag, cited. Guides: our own words, each citing its sources.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.missableWhy: Not by itself: it only asks for the other 54, and the one flagged risk on the way is the Chapter 1 meditation spot [1].
trophies.guide: Collect the other 54 trophies in a single-player save; nothing online or paid is needed for it.
steps: Plan for a long haul rather than a hard one: PowerPyx rates the list 4 out of 10, and both PowerPyx and Beebom put the full run near 200 hours [1][3].
Leave cheats alone, because they switch off trophies and saving for that session [1].
Expect one playthrough with no mission replay and no New Game Plus; free roam stays open after the credits [1][2].
Check the make-up before you start: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver and 46 bronze, 28 of them hidden until earned [4][5].

cites.supports: single-player only, 4/10 difficulty, about 200 hours, cheats block trophies, no replay
no mission replay; free roam after the story
around 200 hours for 100%, 50-60 for the story alone
the official list and its grade split
the split between visible and hidden trophies

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.missableWhy: No: it is the opening story mission, so every playthrough goes through it [1].
trophies.guide: This comes with the very first main mission, so start the story and play that mission to its end.
steps: Start a new game and finish the opening mission of Chapter 1; the trophy unlocks by itself [1].
Stay in Chapter 1 for a while afterwards: OutputLag's checklist puts the first meditation, Cal's fishing and an arcade game in this chapter [2].

cites.supports: Gone Fishing is the first main mission of Chapter 1
chapter checklist for Chapter 1

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.missableWhy: No: chapter trophies come with the main story, which cannot be skipped [1].
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 1 story; the trophy normally shows up as Chapter 2 opens rather than on the last Chapter 1 mission.
steps: Look for the pop at the start of Chapter 2, during What's in the Bag? [1].
Do not worry about a late pop: chapter trophies can wait for the next chapter to begin [2].
Before you move on, meditate at Jason's house, a spot the guides say exists only in Chapter 1 [1][2].

cites.supports: pops when Chapter 2 starts; Chapter 1 meditation warning
chapter trophies can unlock at the next chapter's start

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.missableWhy: No: the story has to pass through Chapter 2 [1].
trophies.guide: Play through the Chapter 2 story; PowerPyx saw this one unlock only once Chapter 3 had begun.
steps: Expect the trophy at the start of Chapter 3, with Welcome to Vice City [1].
Treat a delayed pop as normal: OutputLag notes that chapter trophies can arrive with the following chapter [2].

cites.supports: unlocks as Chapter 3 opens
chapter trophies can lag into the next chapter

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.missableWhy: No: it follows the main story, which cannot be skipped [1].
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3; reports say the trophy only lands after the first two missions of Chapter 4.
steps: Keep playing into Chapter 4: PowerPyx saw it pop after Ocean Beach and Another Life [1].
Before Chapter 3 is over, play Race Against Yago, which OutputLag calls time-sensitive in that chapter [2].

cites.supports: pops after the first two Chapter 4 missions
Race Against Yago is time-sensitive in Chapter 3

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.missableWhy: No: it sits on the main story path [1].
trophies.guide: Complete the Chapter 4 story missions; the trophy unlocks on its own as the chapter closes.
steps: Pick up the optional bank mission That's Where The Money Is... while you are in Chapter 4, since the vault and armored-truck trophies hang off it [1].
Allow for a delay: chapter trophies can pop when the next chapter starts [2].
trophies.unknown: The guides disagree about which mission closes Chapter 4, so SUNLINE does not name it yet.

cites.supports: Chapter 4 story and its optional bank mission
chapter trophies can unlock at the next chapter's start

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.missableWhy: No: it is the end of the story, and PowerPyx calls it unmissable [1].
trophies.guide: Beat the last story mission, but make a manual save first so you keep a way back.
steps: Make a manual save just before the final mission, because missions cannot be replayed [2].
Play it to the end; the trophy is automatic [1].
Carry on after the credits: free roam stays open for everything that is left [1][2].
trophies.unknown: Sources give different names for the final mission, so SUNLINE leaves it unnamed.

cites.supports: automatic, unmissable; free roam after the story
save before the final mission since there is no replay

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.missableWhy: No: Breakfast Run is a main story mission [1].
trophies.guide: Breakfast Run is a Chapter 2 story mission, so this unlocks as you push the main story on.
steps: Follow the main story into Chapter 2 and finish Breakfast Run [1].
Then look around for Chapter 2's side work: Billy, Bret and the gym all open after Coffee Break [1].
Keep a manual save from before the mission if you want to see it again: story missions cannot be replayed [1][2].

cites.supports: Breakfast Run is in Chapter 2; what opens after Coffee Break; no replay
no mission replay, a single playthrough

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.missableWhy: No: The Cartel Heist is a main story mission [1].
trophies.guide: The Cartel Heist is a Chapter 3 story mission; the trophy unlocks once it is done.
steps: Advance Chapter 3 until The Cartel Heist comes up and finish it [1].
Use the chapter's free time for the robbery trophies: Credit Check opens laundering and Yasmani's jobs give you the Snap Gun [1].
Watch for Race Against Yago while Chapter 3 lasts: OutputLag calls it time-sensitive, and it counts for Strangers & Freaks [2].

cites.supports: The Cartel Heist is in Chapter 3; Credit Check and Snap Gun unlocks
Race Against Yago is time-sensitive in Chapter 3 and counts as a strand

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.missableWhy: No: Child's Play is a main story mission [1].
trophies.guide: Child's Play is one of the Chapter 4 story missions; finishing it unlocks the trophy.
steps: Play the Chapter 4 story until Child's Play and see it through [1].
Keep going in order: Headliners and VCIA Takedown in the same chapter carry trophies of their own [1].
Take the optional That's Where The Money Is... when Chapter 4 offers it: it opens the vault jobs behind Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play [1][2].

cites.supports: Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown are Chapter 4 missions; the vault mission
the Chapter 4 vault mission opens the robbery trophies

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.missableWhy: No: Headliners is a main story mission [1].
trophies.guide: Headliners is a Chapter 4 story mission, so this trophy comes as the story runs.
steps: Continue Chapter 4 until Headliners and finish it [1].
Make manual saves between story missions as you go, since none of them can be replayed [2].

cites.supports: Headliners is a Chapter 4 mission
no mission replay

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.missableWhy: No: VCIA Takedown is a main story mission [1].
trophies.guide: VCIA Takedown is the Chapter 4 story mission behind this trophy.
steps: Finish VCIA Takedown when Chapter 4 offers it [1].
Remember the airport for later: stealing a jet from a VCIA boarding bridge is a separate trophy, Catch Me If You Can [1][2].
Save by hand between Chapter 4 missions, because no story mission can be replayed once it is done [2].

cites.supports: VCIA Takedown is a Chapter 4 mission; the jet theft at VCIA
no mission replay; the jet theft at the boarding bridges

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.missableWhy: No: Operation Savage Glory is a main story mission [1].
trophies.guide: Operation Savage Glory belongs to Chapter 5, the last chapter; clear it on the way to the ending.
steps: Push the story into Chapter 5 and finish Operation Savage Glory [1].
Save manually once it is done, ahead of the final mission, which cannot be replayed [2].

cites.supports: Operation Savage Glory is a Chapter 5 mission
keep a save before the final mission

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.missableWhy: No: PowerPyx says nothing on the 100% checklist can be missed [1].
trophies.guide: Work down the 100% checklist once the story ends; whatever you did before the credits already counts.
steps: Open Progress > Stats after the credits to see the checklist, which only appears then [1][2].
Aim for the totals the guides quote: 300 stunts, 70 of the 80 challenges, all 8 bank vaults and all 39 illegal operations [1][2].
Add 15 of the 18 meditation spots and all 15 Target Decks, which PowerPyx also lists [1].
Budget about 100 hours for this step; PowerPyx calls it the hardest trophy on the list [1].
trophies.unknown: The base-vehicle target differs between guides (200 per PowerPyx, 277 per OutputLag), so trust the in-game checklist.

cites.supports: checklist location, its targets, nothing missable, about 100 hours
checklist under Progress > Stats and its targets

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.missableWhy: No: stunts stay on the map in free roam, and any mix of types counts [1].
trophies.guide: Any mix of stunt types counts toward the 250, so lean on whatever kind is nearest.
steps: Fly under bridges: with 202 of them it is the quickest stunt type to farm [1][2].
Add stunt jumps (130), knife flights (40) and base jumps (25) as you pass them [1].
Track the running total in the Progress menu and find spots on the map's Stunt Spots layer [1][2].

cites.supports: 397 stunts by type; under-bridge flights are fastest
under-bridge flights; tracking in the Progress menu

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.missableWhy: No: every activity type stays open in free roam [1].
trophies.guide: Sample every activity type once; a single attempt at each is enough.
steps: Work through the nine types PowerPyx lists: fishing, hunting, golf, the shooting range, pool, basketball hoops, an arcade game, a race and a stunt [1].
Count any race, whether a car race, a race challenge or a drone race [1].
Find them on the map under the blue dumbbell icon [1].

cites.supports: the nine activity types and their map icon

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.missableWhy: No: neither guide flags the ranges, and PowerPyx leaves activities for after the story [1].
trophies.guide: Earn gold on every Shooting Range challenge; the guides count 42 golds in all.
steps: Plan for 42 gold medals spread over 12 ranges, as PowerPyx counts them [1].
Log each gold in the counter as you go, since OutputLag agrees on 42 golds even though it describes the ranges differently [2].
trophies.unknown: The number of ranges differs between sources (12 per PowerPyx, two per OutputLag); the 42-gold total agrees.

cites.supports: 42 golds across 12 ranges
42 golds, with a hedged range count

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.missableWhy: No: drone races are a free-roam activity that neither guide flags [1].
trophies.guide: Win one drone race at each Top Fun location; you do not need every race at a location.
steps: Cover all 14 locations; PowerPyx counts 42 races across them, but one win per location is the goal [1].
Cross-check the location count with OutputLag, which also gives 14 with a hedge [2].

cites.supports: 14 locations, 42 races
14 locations (hedged)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.missableWhy: No: races are a repeatable free-roam activity that neither guide flags [1].
trophies.guide: Win twenty distinct races; winning the same race twice does not add to the count.
steps: Choose from the 40 race locations PowerPyx counts, so half of them will do [1].
Note that car races, race challenges and drone races all count as races for Master of None too [1].
Leave the rest for after the credits if you like: free roam stays open once the story ends [2].

cites.supports: 40 unique race locations; race types
free roam continues after the story

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.missableWhy: No: neither guide flags it; OutputLag simply lists it with the Chapter 1 work [2].
trophies.guide: Follow Cal's fishing questline from Chapter 1 and beat him at his challenge.
steps: Finish the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui; Cal then texts you about a purple fishing spot [1].
Head to that purple marker and keep following his fishing missions until you win [1].

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.missableWhy: No: arcade games stay playable and neither guide flags it [1].

steps: Use the TV at home: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III and Time Jackers Rewind are all listed [1].

Get it done early: OutputLag puts it on the Chapter 1 checklist [2].

Chapter 1 checklist

Work through Climbing the Cellerichain 1-3, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach! and Read the Label before the finale [1].

trophies.guide: Kenton's strand on Key Lento is about shipwrecks and a metal detector; finish his last mission.
steps: Look for Kenton's green KR icon on Key Lento after the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams [1].
Expect him to be away after Chapter 1 and back during Chapters 2 and 3 [1].

trophies.guide: Billy's biker strand starts at the Thrillbilly Mudclub after Coffee Break; ride it through to Hometown Heroes.
steps: Wait for Chapter 2's Coffee Break, then find Billy at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County [1].
Clear Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats and The Impaler on the way [1].

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.missableWhy: Possibly: OutputLag calls Race Against Yago time-sensitive in Chapter 3 [2], so play it there to be safe.
trophies.guide: Finish eight stranger strands, but check which ones count first, because several named side characters do not.
steps: Count on Kirk (the Skunk Ape strand), Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete, which PowerPyx confirms [1].
Do not rely on Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy or Eddie for this total [1][2].
Play Race Against Yago during Chapter 3, because OutputLag calls it time-sensitive [2].
Set aside about 10 hours at the end for the remaining strands [1].
trophies.unknown: Only four counting strands are confirmed so far; the other four are still being identified [1].

trophies.guide: Randy wants a list of high-end sports cars; scan, steal and deliver every one to finish his strand.
steps: Get the Key Cloner, which arrives in Chapter 3 [1].
Scan each of the 16 cars on Randy's Wish List with WAiNK, then drive it to his garage, the green RK icon in west Vice City [1].

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.missableWhy: No: the challenge list stays open after the story and neither guide flags it [1].
trophies.guide: Finish fifty of the game's challenges; push on to seventy if you are going for 100%.
steps: Open Progress > Challenges to see the full list of 80 [1][2].

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.missableWhy: No: you can raise a wanted level again at any time, and it often pops during later jobs anyway [1].
trophies.guide: Once partner play opens after Coffee Break, raise a four-star wanted level with your partner and shake it off together.
steps: Call your partner in by holding D-pad right and pressing Triangle [1].
Hide in the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County to lose the police [1].
Wait until you are out of the red heat zone, which is when it pops [1][2].
Do not stress if it lags: it often unlocks during the Chapter 4 vault jobs [1].

cites.supports: partner call input, the tunnel tip, Chapter 4 vault jobs

Keep the flashing red-and-blue wanted state going, and do not let it fade to the red heat zone between shops [1][2].
Use the three jewelry stores in north Vice City, which sit close together [1].
Give it about 30 seconds after the third robbery to pop [1].
